title: PipelineForge JSON Pipeline Configuration Schema
description: Target JSON Schema for migrating PipelineForge .pfcfg configuration trees to JSON while preserving evaluation semantics, ordering, conditional directives, and variable interpolation.

imports.description: Ordered list of external configuration files to merge before local sections.

path.description: Relative file path of the configuration file to include.

once.description: If true (@include_once), skips loading if already included in current execution tree.

env_set.description: Environment variable that must be set and non-empty for this import to execute.

env_unset.description: Environment variable that must be unset or empty for this import to execute.

sections.description: Map of section names (e.g., 'build', 'notify.slack') to key-value configuration pairs.

overrides.description: Ordered list of conditional blocks (@ifdef/@ifndef) applied after static sections.

when.description: Condition required to apply the override sections.

env_set.description: Environment variable that must be set and non-empty.

env_unset.description: Environment variable that must be unset or empty.

sections.description: Sections and key-value pairs to merge if the condition evaluates to true.
